_comment: The map database of D33: reveal tuning and every landmark the map may ever show. Data-driven so Band 1-4 landmarks (quarry, warrens, river, mill, relay) join by editing this file, not code. Tunable.
_comment_regions: Owner directive, playtest pass: 'name some of the areas and uncover them like fortnite maps do.' A region is broader than a landmark -- the AREA around a point of interest, not the point itself -- and is discovered by entering it (map_state.gd::update_region), not by proximity like a landmark. Centres and names come straight from data/config/terrain_playground.json's own paths.routes[].label and paths.trailheads[].label, which already name these five areas ("the square to Grandpa's door", "the square to the practice meadow", etc) -- this file just gives the same places entry radii. Village Square is its own region distinct from the 'village' landmark above: the landmark is the discoverable POI marker, the region is the whole hub the player is standing in the moment they arrive. TUNABLE.
